seriesTitle: This World Can't Tear Me Down

episodes.title: Quel che è di Cesare
episodes.summary: At the police station, Zero mulls over threatening posters in his neighborhood, stresses over an upcoming TV interview and runs into an old friend.

episodes.title: Come una balena spiaggiata
episodes.summary: Zero remembers first meeting Cesare at an arcade in the 80s. Later, he dines at Cesare's house at his mother's invitation and tears down more posters.

episodes.title: Il faro
episodes.summary: Looking back on their time as teenagers, Zero and the Armadillo try to untangle why Cesare became the way he is now and attempt to reason with him.

episodes.title: Chi denuncia per primo è infame due volte
episodes.summary: Zero recalls the moment that caused his friendship with Cesare to fracture. Torn between her ideals and her dream job, Sarah faces heat from her friends.

episodes.title: Quattro miliardi di anni luce
episodes.summary: With the town hall upon them and violence looming, Zero wants to leave — but when Secco opens up about his troubled upbringing, he chooses justice.

episodes.title: Non c'è un posto per te
episodes.summary: Both sides are at a stalemate. As Cesare's time in the spotlight comes to pass, a riot breaks out. In the center of the fray, Zero has an epiphany.
